description: W2: the eight diverse prompts (code_py, code_rust, prose_story, prose_explain, tool_agentic, multi_zh, multi_es_ja, math_reason) of competitive/r9700x2/prompts/diverse.json, byte-identical texts and tools. Stream i of a W2 cell sends request i % 8 as one user message (plus its tools), so C8 is eight different prompts, C4 the first four.

requests.name: code_py
requests.text:
from typing import List


def has_close_elements(numbers: List[float], threshold: float) -> bool:
    """ Check if in given list of numbers, are any two numbers closer to each other than
    given threshold.
    >>> has_close_elements([1.0, 2.0, 3.0], 0.5)
    False
    >>> has_close_elements([1.0, 2.8, 3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 2.0], 0.3)
    True
    """

requests.name: code_rust
requests.text: Write a Rust function `parse_csv_line(line: &str) -> Vec<String>` that handles quoted fields containing commas and escaped double quotes (""). Include three unit tests and a short explanation of the edge cases.

requests.name: prose_story
requests.text: Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a sealed brass canister washed ashore after a storm. Keep it under 250 words.

requests.name: prose_explain
requests.text: Explain in about 300 words why the sky is blue during the day and why sunsets look red, for a curious high-school student. Use one everyday analogy.

requests.name: tool_agentic
requests.text: I'm flying from Seattle to Tokyo next Tuesday and I will land in the evening. Find out what the weather will be like in Tokyo then, and look up the cheapest flights. Use the tools you have.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the weather forecast for a city on a date

requests.name: multi_zh
requests.text: 请用中文写一段关于杭州西湖四季变化的描写,约300字,要有画面感,并在结尾加上一句诗。

requests.name: multi_es_ja
requests.text: Traduce al japonés la frase «Ayer fui al mercado con mi hermana y compramos manzanas y pan», y explica brevemente la gramática de cada parte en español.

requests.name: math_reason
requests.text: A train leaves city A at 3:00 pm travelling at 60 mph. A second train leaves city B, 270 miles away, at 3:45 pm travelling toward A at 75 mph. At what time do they meet and how far from A? Work step by step and double-check the arithmetic.
